title: Here’s what happened in crypto today

title: Blur is shutting down its website, so why are NFT collectors cheering?

title: Binance to shut down crypto mining pool services in November

title: Aptos rolls out Encrypted Mempool to curb frontrunning, sandwich attacks

title: FTX’s crypto mining venture is now used to advance AI

title: Crypto PACs report $2.7M spending blitz on House races as midterms loom

title: US accounting overhaul could make stablecoins more attractive to corporations: Tempo

title: Bitcoin miners face widening AI financing costs as lenders scrutinize deals
